notes.title: Market Tycoon Update Version 1.5.2
notes.notes:
Hey Market Tycoon Fans,

Welcome to update 1.5.2

So, it has been some time since the last update. We've been working on getting a new huge market which is exactly what this update is all about.

In this update, you will have a new market to play on which is about 4x bigger than the old bigger market. And with the countless items that you can get from the Steam Workshop thanks to our community, you will be able to fill up your new market with many items for your customers.

Of course, there are the usual bug fixes and minor improvements as always. We will continue with more patches and improvements for the few next small updates.

As for the next update we are looking to add new gameplay features like day/night cycle and different working shifts and many more.

For more frequent updates about the development of Market Tycoon, join our Discord server by clicking here

That's all for now, more big things to come soon.

notes.title: Market Tycoon Update V. 1.5.1
notes.notes:
Hi Market Tycoon Fans,

This is the biggest content update to date for Market Tycoon. There are a lot of improvements and new features so let's get right into it.

First, continuing on what we started with the previous update (Introducing Workshop for Market Tycoon) You can now add wall and floor paint to Steam Workshop for Market Tycoon. You can view the updated guide here for more information on how to use the tool.

Now let's get to the exciting stuff.
New market! Yes! There is a new bigger market with this update. The new market is twice as big as the older bigger market. And the good news is, another even bigger market is on the works for the next update so stay tuned.

Another heavily requested feature is decorations, and so here it is. With this version, there are 12 different pots and plants to decorate your market and 5 indoor fountains and one wall-mounted fountain for you to add to your markets. Not only that, but we also added two posters a wall mounted poster and a standing poster in which you can choose an item to promote for better sales (More poster designs coming in a future update)

On top of the new decorations, we also added 5 new fridges, 5 freezers, and one new rack. We are very excited to see how you will use all those new features and content to create spectacular looking markets. If you haven't done so already, join our discord server to share images of your market and stay up to date with the development of Market Tycoon.

As usual with any update, there are many small bug fixes and game balances and improvements. The graphic when placing an object has changed not to a grid visual that looks much better than previous updates and a new cool smoke effect when selling an object.

Please note that saved games prior to this version are not compatible with the new version.

That's it for now, update Market Tycoon now and enjoy the new features!

notes.title: Market Tycoon Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hi Market Tycoon Fans,

Here with another update. We have some good news and some bad news.

We will start with the bad news as we like to keep the best for last. The bad news is we will delay the next update, but for a good reason that you'll like.

Here with the good news. As you know we are working on a tool to support Steam workshop which will allow you yo make content like items, objects, paint, etc.

We decided that to make this tool as useful as possible we have to make all items fit anywhere if it can physically fit within a shelf, not only items made with the tools but of course items that are already in-game. 

The way you place items on shelves now is using a preset number of items that may or may not fit in some shelves, fridges, or freezers some items have more or less as you can see from the items menu or using the arrow keys and you'll notice there is a maximum of 3 presets but most have only one.
We are working on a new system that will take each item and place it on a shelf one-by-one until it is full or as many as you want. For example, right now, if you want to place a set of apples you are forced to place 20 apples (unless you are restocking, but you will only able to restock on the place of the missing apples from those 20) the new system will allow you to place from 1 piece and up to the maximum number of apple that can physically fit in the given shelf. And that will apply to all items.

We are sorry again for the delay of this update but we hope you like what is coming and understand the reason for the delay, it will only bring you a better more polished product.

We are looking at a time frame from 2-4 weeks but we'll try our best to get it sooner.

Thanks for your continued support of Market Tycoon many exciting stuff is yet to come.

notes.title: Market Tycoon Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hello Market Tycoon Fans,

Many asked when is the next update? Here to let you know our plans.

When we first started developing the game it was supposed to be much smaller than it is right now, as we didn't expect that much people will like it or be interested in the game. So thanks for everyone's continued support for the game.

And as you know the next big thing for Market Tycoon is workshop, and since we didn't plan for the game to be this big there were no plans to add workshop/mod support when we first started. After seeing the number of people that liked the game our goals changed for a bigger game with much more features than planned. As you can notice the last 2 updates last of which was a little over a week ago were all about bug fixes but what we didn't say is these updates also uses a new code that can accommodate workshop support.

Right now we are working on building tools for the community to use to make items, objects, paints, and eventually markets (We also want to add decorations and posters to the game which of course the community would be able to make more of). Initially, the tool will support making items and then the other stuff will be added to the tool as it gets ready. We are trying to make the tool as easy to use as possible and we are figuring out the best way to do so. Plans of how the tool will work are laid out and we'll start working on it in the upcoming days. We expect the tool will be ready for making items sometime next month but we can't guarantee exact timing yet, but be assured it's coming soon enough.

Thank you for your continued support for Market Tycoon.

notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.4.4 (Bug Fixes & Future Update)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for your patience for this update, we understand that this took too long.

Let's get into it, this update is kinda small in terms of gameplay but it improved on core game code setting it up for the support of Steam Workshop.

We focused on fixing bugs for this one but the main thing is that we rewrote the entirety of the code that handled the placement of items which took a lot of time. You might notice that most items can now be placed on shelves that weren't allowed to be placed there while it should have been. Previously items had a predefined list of shelves that can go into but now it calculates if it physically fit and of course whether an item is getting placed in a shelf, fridge, or freezer.

Many small bugs were fixed and improvements have been made. One big improvement is that when you train a cashier employee you had to click on the cashier and open it manually after training is done, that confused a lot of players on thinking that the employee just never comes back. Now, with this update, the employee automatically returns once training is done.



For the next update, we are planning on developing the tool for Steam Workshop that will initially let the community make items and later all sort of stuff like cashiers, shelves, fridges, freezers, [spoiler]decorations[/spoiler],  paint, and even the market itself.

Also, we want to optimize the game more especially with the UI so let us know what you want us to focus on more in our Discord server which you can  join from here: https://discord.gg/Pzf4A2g


Thank you again for your patience for this update we have a lot of exciting ideas which will make this game much more fun.

notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.4.3 (Huge Optimization Update and Future Plans)
notes.notes:
Hello there,

As we promised in giving you an update that will focus on optimizing the game, here it is.

We have received a number of complaints about lag and performance issues, and we are happy to let you know that with this update this issue is from the past. We were able to boost the performance from 15fps in some cases to 60fps.

And as you know with the last update, your old markets disappeared from the loading screen and as we explained that this was due to changes in core game code. We are happy to let you know that we were able to work around that and make most of your old markets loadable again. And with the new optimization, you can now enjoy your market with no lag.


As for the future, we would really love to bring workshop support for Market Tycoon and we are so excited to see what the community can bring to Market Tycoon. We also have plans for more features like janitors, security guards, thieves, disasters like rat infestation, online website for your market. Things like that will make the game more interesting and fun.

Thanks for your support and for everyone that sent in a bug report and helping us make Market Tycoon a better game.

Enjoy,

notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.4.2 (Bug Fixes and Road-map)
notes.notes:
Hey Market Tycoon Fans,

As many of you might have heard, we are working on bringing workshop support to Market Tycoon. Unfortunately, when we started developing Market Tycoon we did not plan to have workshop ready to be supported in the future. Therefore, we need to change many core game code to make it compatible with Workshop and that is taking some time. We are happy to let you know that work on that has already started and there is some real good progress going on that. We are so excited to see what you guys can come up with. Stay tuned Workshop is officially on the way to Market Tycoon.

Meanwhile, we worked on fixing bugs that were reported over the last two months or so and this is what this update is all about. We focused mainly on those bugs that caused people or employees to get stuck in their place. Please note that if you faced this bug in your market there is a small chance that it will not get fixed in this market and you might need to start a new game, but it should not happen again.

We also know that many are facing some performance problems, and that is what we are focusing on next. So expect an update very very soon to address the performance problems. After the next update which will focus on performance, we will get back to work on getting Workshop ready to use with Market Tycoon.

We had plans to get the UI more friendly with the visually impaired on this update. Unfortunately, it didn't look as good as we wanted it to be. We are still working on that and we'll release a small update once it's ready.

Updating the translations of German, French, Catalan and few more languages are being worked on and will become available automatically without needing to update the game once it's ready.

Thanks for everyone that continues to support Market Tycoon. We still have many other exciting features planned like website for your market, thieves and guards, disasters, opening times and better employee management and much much more.



If you want your market to be featured in the main menu screen in the game or the loading screen, use the "Send Marketing Package" button from the pause menu while in game.

If you haven't joined our Discord server yet, you can do so by using this link: https://discord.gg/Pzf4A2g let us know what you think and what you want to see next we are always listening to you.

notes.title: Market Tycoon 1.3.0 Update (Biggest Update So Far)
notes.notes:
Finally, after many delays Market Tycoon 1.3.0 is here.

First, we want to apologize for the many delays of this update, we wanted to give you the best we can and couldn't just rush things and give a flawed product. We hope that you'd understand.


So let's get into it, what's new?

Setting aside all the background improvements, bug fixes, and optimization let's tell you about the new features.

• Employee Uniform
This feature has been asked from the beginning, and it finally made it. We remember when many of you asked for this feature, but it didn't make much sense at the time, you only had one employee option which was cashiers. There are more than cashiers now (more on that later). For this feature, you will be able to choose the style of the uniform, as well as any color you can imagine with HSV sliders which will give you a wide range of colors to choose from and easily find the color you want.

• Cargo Vans and Storage
Did this catch your attention? This is loads of fun and opens an interesting potential feature for later updates like launching a website for your market and selling items through the internet (Planned feature). So what is this? After placing your item, the item will not instantly get on the shelf (More on that next). You'll have to buy a cargo van ·send it to go and get your ordered items to your storage. And your items will remain in your storage until it expires or...... (see next)

• Stocking Employee
Yes, stocking employee, the game now is much more fun and realistic. So how this will work? Well, you will no longer be able to instantly place items into shelves. You'll have to hire stocking employees that will stock your items from the storage. So basically, you will place items just like you did before but the item will be semi-transparent indicating that the item isn't' there yet. Once you have your item placed stocking employees will stock your items from the storage to the shelves. Now you will have to think and manage the quantity of an item you want to have. you don't want to have too much and risk losing it when it expires, and you don't want to have too little and lose potential profit you would have made while ordering ·more items and stocking it.

• New Markets
This is the most noticeable thing on this update. With the introduction of the storage area which the old market didn't have, we had to make new markets. On this update, we have two markets. So, and for the lack of the storage area which is necessary to support the new ·features, the old markets have been removed. Therefore, you will no longer be able to load any saved games before this update.

• Other Small New Features (Graphics, Camera Movement)
With the introduction of the new markets, we have drastically updated the graphics and the look of the game. And ·to give more views of your market, now you can pan the camera up and down by moving the mouse up or down when rotating the camera. We hope that you'll like how the game looks now as much as we did.

And that pretty much summarize the new features for this update, and as we said earlier there are many improvements on how things work in the background as well as loads of bugs that have been fixed many of them thanks to the bug reports we received from you over the past couple of months.



What's next?
One of the features we wanted to include in this update was a brand new UI. Unfortunately, we wouldn't have been able to make it on time.

So, here is the plan for the next couple of updates*

[strike]• Market Tycoon 1.3.1	[/strike]
Brand new UI. The whole UI of the game will be recreated to look prettier and more user-friendly.

[strike]• Market Tycoon 1.3.2	[/strike]
Steam Achievements, trading cards, and macOS support

[strike]• Market Tycoon 1.3.3	[/strike]
More content. Anything from items, shelves, fridges, freezers, etc...

[strike]• Market Tycoon 1.3.4	[/strike]
More features.



Now we need a small favor from you. Due to the new markets and the updated graphics we need new screenshots for Market Tycoon for both our website and the steam store page. To help us have great screenshots for the game and have a chance for your market to be featured as a screenshot on our website and the steam store page, make sure you have an internet connection and hold Ctrl + U to send us screenshots. Please give it a few seconds for the screenshots to be sent (time will depend on your internet speed).

If you have a good understanding in English and would like to contribute to translating Market Tycoon to other languages please contact us through ·email contact@protectiongames.com
Please don't hesitate to contact us even if Market Tycoon is already translated into your language. The more translators we have the faster and better quality of translation can be achieved for the speakers of your language.


Please note that due to the many new features added in this update, translation to your language might not be up to date yet. The translation should automatically update once it's available.


Thank you for your continued support for Market Tycoon. Have fun!


*Subject to change



[spoiler]Did you notice the secret message in this announcement?[/spoiler]

notes.title: Quick Dev Update for Market Tycoon V. 1.2.5
notes.notes:
Hi Market Tycoon fans,

In this Quick Dev Update, we will let you know what to expect from the next Market Tycoon update.

This is going to be a big update. It has taken longer than expected, but we also did more than we planned.


First of all, new languages

In the next update, Market Tycoon will support three new languages.
And these languages are:


•Portugues, brasileiro (Brazilian portuguese)
•Svenska (Swedish)
•български (Bulgarian)


Making the total of languages supporting Market Tycoon nine languages which are:


•English
•Deutsch (German)
•Français (French)
•Română (Romanian)
•Čeština (Czech)
•العربية
•Portugues, brasileiro (Brazilian portuguese)
•Svenska (Swedish)
•български (Bulgarian)



This update is also very focused on optimizing performance and bug fixing. And so, we have completely rewritten the AI script for both a better performance and bug fixing. We also rewriting and fixed many other smaller scripts in game.

We are also adding at least one new map and very exciting new features like fridges and cashiers going down and sparking (for more realism and more fun gameplay).


Stay tuned for the next update,

notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.2.3 (Loading and Small Bug Fixes)
notes.notes:
In this update of Market Tycoon:

• Previously, there was no loading screen in the game. Any game needs to load data, with Market Tycoon the game looked like it freezed but in reality, it was loading the data. Now, we have implemented loading screen which will help players not have the feeling of the game freezing or not working.

The loading screen has images of markets made in Market Tycoon. To have your market being featured on a loading screen in a future update of Market Tycoon, while in-game hold Ctrl and hit U, the game will freeze for a few seconds or depending on your internet speed as a screenshot of your market is being uploaded and sent to us. If we liked your market, you might see it on a loading screen in a future update.


Thank you and please if you found any bugs, let us know through our email contact@protectiongames.com or use the bug report feature from the pause screen on the game or post on the Bug Reports thread here.

And please if you liked the game, give us a positive review it will really help us make Market Tycoon a better game.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.2.0 (Biggest Update Yet. New Languages, New Features and Bug Fixes)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, it's been a while since the last update and we hope this update will worth the waiting.

As you can see from the title, this is the biggest update Market Tycoon has every received and there is a lot of new features and bug fixes, so let's go into it.


First, what has been fixed:

• Fixed restock all showing the wrong price. (When hovering over the restock button it tells you how much restocking the shelf will cost, the value here was totally wrong and now has been fixed)

• Fixed item getting rotated in the wrong direction. (Sometimes when moving a shelf with items in it and rotating the shelf, the item stay in the same direction before rotating the shelf, this has been fixed with this version) It's worth mentioning that if you experienced this bug before, the affected items might not be fixed but this bug will not happen again.

• Fixed a bug where item popularity doesn't get loaded.

• Fixed a bug where the "?" sign not going away next to popularity when when "+" or "-" is added.

• Fixed item sales amount not getting saved on Quick Qtats and [spoiler] Price Change[/spoiler] page

• Fixed a bug where people get stuck next to the door or cashier.


Next, Improvements:

• A small improvement in AI pathfinding.

• Optimized game performance especially when placing items.

• Small Graphics/Color changes. Here are the before and after images.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28751995/e083acb7b15e1ae97416414ea44ddec4517a81e7.jpg
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28751995/9dfe6a9977e25c5de6bbd91ee8e461f35e16d07c.jpg

And there are many many more smaller bug fixes and improvements.


Now, the fun part. What's new:

• Many asked for this feature, Price Change. Yes, now you can increase or decrease prices. (Changed "Quick Stats & Discount" to "Quick Stats and Price Change")

• Another asked feature is item sort and item search, now you can search for items instead of finding it and/or sort by:
1- Alphabetically
2- Price Low-High
3- Price High-Low
4- Sales High-Low
5- SalesHigh-Low
6- Popularity

• Exit tabs and pages by clicking ESC.

• 64 brand new item. discover them.

• Customer comment. Now, customers will give comments about your market, so you could know what is working well or why your market rating is bad. Here is an example image:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28751995/9b1008b51fefdd99db34b5c7fd24dd53758078e6.jpg

• Another really cool feature is Expiry Report. What is this feature you might ask? Now you can know exactly how many items are going to expire on a certain day. Here is an image:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28751995/d877652a95d98de9df8995d3132e215848bc28cc.jpg

• And for people in Arab world, France and Romania, we are happy to tell you that Market Tycoon supports Arabic, French and Romanian languages. Russian Language is coming in the next update. 
If you have a good understanding in English and would like to help translate Market Tycoon to your language contact us by sending an email to contact@protectiongames.com


Now we need a favour from you. We are planning on having a loading screen with market images, to do that, while in-game hold Ctrl and hit U the game will freeze for a few seconds or depending on your internet speed as a screenshot of your market is being uploaded and sent to us. If we liked your market, you might see it on a loading screen in a future update.


There are much more planned features to come in the future as we sail along in the development of Market Tycoon.

That's it for now and thank you for waiting for this update.

V. 1.2.0 P.1 (8/22/2017): 
This is a very small patch release fixing a bug when sorting items.

V. 1.2.0 P.2 (8/23/2017): 
Another patch release, fixing some game loading issues reported by some players. And fixed a bug where the people are stuck next to shelves.
If you have placed hot sauce or chili sauce in your market before this patch they might be rotated the wrong way, this bug however will not happen if you placed a new pack of hot sauce or chili sauce.

notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.1.26 (Bug Fixes)
notes.notes:
This might be the last update in the 1.1.X cycle. We are planning for a big update very soon so stay tuned.

In this version of Market Tycoon, we fixed a lot of bugs and added small new features.


This update includes, but not limited to:

• Fixed a bug that leads to losing all save games when upgrading a market. (Your old game save should be automatically retrievable)
• Fixed a bug where price animation of the restocked item won't show.
• Fixed a bug that leads to an inaccurate number of items or items itself in the shelf when clicking on the shelf.
• Few other bug fixes and improvements.

• Added an in-game bug reporter on the pause menu.
• Spacebar now pauses and unpause the game when pressed.
• Advertising has much more effect.
	

If you are still in the open beta version 1.1.23 B.1, it's highly recommended to opt out of the beta as there is nothing special in it, as all the features in the open beta is now in the final build, plus many more bug fixes. (If V. 1.1.23 B.1 watermark is on the lower left corner in the main menu it means that you are in the open beta version, so it's highly recommended that you opt-out)


In case you missed it, we are starting to translate Market Tycoon to other languages.

If you are interested in translating Market Tycoon to your language and want to contribute to making that happen, send us an email at Contact@ProtectionGames.com with the subject "Market Tycoon Translation" and in the message type the language you will be translating Market Tycoon to.

Requirements to translate Market Tycoon:
• Good understanding in English as you will be translating from English.
• Good understanding of the language you will be translating Market Tycoon to, preferably a native speaker, so if you are a native speaker of the language you will be translating to mention that in the email.


Thank you and please if you found any bugs, let us know through our email contact@protectiongames.com or post on the Bug Reports thread here.

notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.1.23 (Bug Fixes, Improvements, and Join The Beta)
notes.notes:
In this version of Market Tycoon, we fixed a lot of bugs reported in the Bug Reports thread.


This update includes, but not limited to:

• Increased day length by ~13% (~42% from original length of day)
• Hold Shift to view placing indicator introduced with Market Tycoon V. 1.1.22
• Fire/Hire cashier while paused.
• A bunch of bug fixes and improvements.


Now we have a very exciting news, we are now running an Open Beta for Market Tycoon and if you would like to opt-in here is how:

1- Find Market Tycoon in your Steam library.
2- Right click on Market Tycoon and click on Properties.
3- Click on the BETAS tab and from the drop-down window select openbeta.

That's it you are now on the beta version of Market Tycoon. 

Here is what's new with on the beta version of Market Tycoon 1.1.23 B.1:

This feature has not been tested enough, and instead of publishing it to everyone, we would like for those who would like to try it out early to tell us how they find the rating system is and if it needs any improvements/changes.

We have many more exciting features in plan thanks to the community ideas, and we are working to bring them to you.

Thank you and please if you found any bugs, let us know through our email contact@protectiongames.com or post on the Bug Reports thread here.

notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.1.6 (Bug Fixes and Multiple Game Saves)
notes.notes:
In this update, multiple game saves feature has been added. notes.title: Market Tycoon V. 1.0.9 (Bug fixes)
notes.notes:
This Update comes with many bug fixes, and this update include but not limited to

•Save/Load issues. (We found a bug on the required save data, old save data may be corrupted, thus old saved games MIGHT not load, new games should save and load properly)

•Fixed restock button not clicking.

•Reduced character jittering.

•Minor bug fixes.


As far as the characters getting stuck bug, we are still working on it and we expect it to be solved within a few days, for the moment, a workaround is to either sell the rack, fridge, or freezer that the characters are getting stuck next to or moving the rack, fridge, or freezer and placing it back again. You can also just move a rack, fridge, or freezer across the stuck characters to let the system recalculate its path. 

Again we are sorry for the inconvenience, we will try to fix this bug a soon as we can.
